message.content:
Based on my search, **Barry Watson** played the oldest brother in *7th Heaven*. He portrayed **Matt Camden**, the eldest son of Reverend Eric and Annie Camden. Matt was the oldest sibling in the Camden family, which included Mary, Lucy, Simon, Ruthie, and twin brothers Sam and David.

Barry Watson was a main cast member from seasons 1-6 and made guest appearances in later seasons. He left the show in 2002 when he was diagnosed with Hodgkin's Lymphoma, though he had made the decision to leave prior to his diagnosis. He returned for several episodes in seasons 7-10.
